how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:druid-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:30:obj:0: Find the ⟦E1⟧ and the ⟦E2⟧. Speak with the residents of ⟦E3⟧ to learn clues as to where these items may be located.
rows.quest:30:obj:1: Form the ⟦E5⟧ from the two pendant halves. You need to be in proximity of the Shrine of Remulos to do this.
rows.quest:30:obj:2: Bring the joined pendant to ⟦E6⟧ in the village of Nighthaven, ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:30:details:0: For the second trial, you'll need the two halves that make the ⟦E5⟧. One half draws power from the agility of the sea lion aspect, gliding through water; the other draws power from the incredible endurance of the sea lion aspect. Druids draw on both these traits equally to embody the aspect of their aquatic form.
rows.quest:30:details:1: Speak with the locals of ⟦E3⟧ to learn where the parts may lie, and bring both here to join them together. Once formed, take the pendant to ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:30:progress:0: Have you formed your pendant for me to inspect, ⟦1⟧? If you need help in locating the parts, try asking the local populace for information. Not only will you find what you seek, but it will give you a reason to explore this wondrous and sacred glade.
rows.quest:30:completion:1: Each task in acquiring the pendant shows that both agility and endurance are necessary to act in harmony with what you desire to do underwater. Neither can exist without the other, and both cannot be done without your willingness to embrace the aspect of the sea lion.
rows.quest:30:completion:2: Remember these lessons well, and count on them once you have gained your aquatic form.
rows.quest:31:details:0: You have completed the necessary lessons all young druids are taught before they can adopt an aquatic aspect. Go now back to your trainer, ⟦E11⟧, in ⟦E13⟧. Show him your pendant and prove to him you are ready to learn what he has to teach you. He will complete your training, allowing you to become one with the water.
rows.quest:31:details:1: Goodbye, young druid. We shall speak again.
rows.quest:31:progress:0: Your return to ⟦E13⟧ is not without heralding, though I will need proof of your lessons learned in ⟦E3⟧ before I will teach you your aquatic form.⟦3⟧⟦4⟧Do you have the ⟦E5⟧?
rows.quest:31:completion:0: Very impressive, ⟦5⟧. Your ancestors would be pleased with your progress! You're ready to learn your aquatic form, and it is my pleasure to teach it to you.
rows.quest:31:completion:1: Also, in recognition of your achievement during the two trials, I give you this item. I hope you'll find it to be a welcome addition to your gear as a protector of nature and a keeper of the balance.

rows.quest:9051:obj:0: Stab a ⟦E16⟧ with the ⟦E17⟧. Return to ⟦E18⟧ in ⟦E19⟧ when you have completed this task.
rows.quest:9051:details:0: The toxin you helped me create is for a special purpose. The great devilsaurs of the crater make it dangerous to hunt and difficult for me to survive. Even if I possessed the necessary strength, killing a devilsaur simply allows another to move into its territory.
rows.quest:9051:details:1: Take this poisoned barb and stab it deep into a living devilsaur. The toxin should pacify the creature, though I do not know how quickly...
rows.quest:9051:progress:0: Were you able to pacify the great beast?
rows.quest:9051:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦11⟧. You are brave and wise.
rows.quest:9051:completion:1: Tell me, how did the devilsaur react to the toxin?
rows.quest:9052:obj:0: Collect 8 ⟦E20⟧ and 8 Gorishi Stings, and return to ⟦E18⟧ in ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:9052:details:0: I would ask you to help me create a toxin of sorts, to pacify a great creature living here in the crater. It is not deadly, and only the keen eyes of a ⟦12⟧ can hope to collect the ingredients.
rows.quest:9052:details:1: You can find the bloodcap ⟦E21⟧ growing within the bloodpetal sprouts all across the crater. Gorishi stings are from the insects inside and around the Slithering Scar, located in the southern part of the crater.
rows.quest:9052:completion:1: With the Un'Goro soil I have collected, the toxin is easily concocted...
rows.quest:9053:obj:0: Retrieve a ⟦E22⟧ from the guardian at the bottom of the ⟦E23⟧ and return to ⟦E18⟧.
rows.quest:9053:details:0: It is as I feared -- the toxin is simply too weak for such a powerful creature.
rows.quest:9053:details:1: If we are to create a toxin of high enough potency, you must venture to the bottom of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, unlock the secrets of the altar and recover a putrid vine from the guardian there. The temple is dangerous, and it would behoove you to bring friends.
rows.quest:9053:details:2: Return to me when this is done.
rows.quest:9053:completion:0: At last, the toxin can be created in full. I dare not require you to inflict it upon the creature again, as I have asked too much already.
rows.quest:9053:completion:1: You have my thanks and respect. May you be well in your travels, ⟦13⟧.
rows.quest:9063:details:0: A hunter by the name of ⟦E18⟧ has requested the help of a druid. He said only we would possess the necessary skills and respect for nature to help him.
rows.quest:9063:details:1: There is a road that connects the ⟦E19⟧ and the desert of ⟦E24⟧. As that road enters the crater, you will find Torwa close by.
rows.quest:9063:completion:0: You have traveled far to meet with me, ⟦14⟧, and not a moment too soon.
